title.narrative: Higher Education in the Pacific Investment Program - Tranche 2

description.narrative:
Tranche 2 (with additional financing) supports the expansion of the University of the South Pacific (USP) regional campus in Solomon Islands to a new location in Honiara. The scope of Project 2 includes (i) construction of classrooms, an ICT studio, faculty offices, administrative facilities, and a clean energy component supporting a solar photo-voltaic system; (ii) enhanced information and communication technology (ICT)-based education, (iii) improved USP student services, and (iv) strengthened USP governance and management.
Tranche 2 will enable the USP regional campus to accommodate an increasing demand for higher education, improve the quality of education through the use of ICT and adoption of distance flexible learning. Public Health will be the anchor program for the campus. Tranche 2 will also help improve USP student services through provision of career counseling services, and strengthen governance and management capacity of USP by implementing an education management information system for improved data collection and analysis of USP activities and human resources.
